strategy_notes: Localized the bicolor yellow-white mug, porcelain white mug, and both ceramic plate centers from agentview plus wrist back-projection. Winning recipe order: (1) pre-position at the yellow handle, pi0 grasp handle loop (step 2), firm and lift; (2) rotate +90deg to redirect the held offset, carry via move_pose to the viewer-left/world -y plate, descend supported, release (step 9); (3) retreat and unwind; (4) pre-position at porcelain, pi0 grasp handle (step 13), firm/lift; (5) rotate +90deg to redirect the -y hang, carry via move_pose to viewer-right/world +y plate, descend supported, release (step 20), which terminated after 3 release steps.
